messages.subject: INLA.Data1
parts:
When I run the main function [inla] of the INLA package, the function reports an error:
--------------------
*** ERROR *** INLA.Data1: BINOMIAL likelihood is defined on integers, but y[1089] = 17.01
--------------------
But I didn't find the data INLA.Data1 in my rstudio variable environment, so I don't know how to deal with this error. I would like to ask if this is temporary data generated by the function run and what I can do to deal with this?

Also
---------------------
Warning in inla.core(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts, :)
  f(j, ...) : Number of unused groups >= the number of groups used: 5 >= 1, this is *usually* a misspesification
--------------------
This error also appears inside the function output, should I adjust the in-time grouping?

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA.Data1

reported in the error msg
